description_sq:
Shitet, Apartament 2+1+blk, 21 Dhjetori – prane Hotel Mondial, 258,000 Euro
Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Apartament 2+1+blk
– Zona 21 Dhjetori
– Rruga Muhamet Gjollesha
– Kati 3 banim, me ashensor
– Pallat i ri 7-të katesh
– Siperfaqja bruto 103m²
– Siperfaqja neto 94.5m²
– Hyrje direkte nga rruga kryesore
– Shkalle me ndricim natyral
– I veshur me sistem kapot
– Orientim Jug-Perendim
– Cmimi 258,000 Euro
Shitet Apartament 2+1+blk , me siperfaqe totale 103m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 3 banim ne nje pallati 7-katesh me ashensor ne Rrugen Muhamet Gjollesha. Pallati eshte i veshur me sistem kapot, shkalla eshte e ndricuar natyralisht, me hyrje nga rruga kryesore.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron akses te menjehereshem ne rrugen kryesore, linja urbane, sherbime, universitete dhe cdo facilitet tjeter te nevojshem.
Apartamenti organizohet ne sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi, tualeti dhe ballkoni. Avantazhi i prones eshte planimetria funksionale me mundesi ndarje ne 2 apartamente.
Orientim Jug-Perendim, duke ofruar ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites.
Apartamenti pershtatet si per banim ashtu dhe per aktivitete biznesi, si zyra, klinika, studio etj.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: For sale, Apartment 2+1+blk, December 21 - near Hotel Mondial, 258,000 Euros
description_en: For sale, Apartment 2+1+blk, 21 Djetori - near Hotel Mondial, 258,000 Euro Property Features: - Apartment 2+1+blk - Area 21 Djetori - Muhamet Gjollesha Street - 3rd residential floor, with elevator - New 7-storey building - Gross area 103m² - Net area 94.5m² - Direct entrance from the main road - Staircase with natural light - Covered with kapot system - Orientation South-West - Price 258,000 Euro 2+1+blk apartment for sale, with a total area of 103m², which is located on the 3rd residential floor in a 7-story building with an elevator on Muhamet Gjollesha Street. The building is covered with a capot system, the staircase is naturally lit, with an entrance from the main road. The area in which the apartment is located offers immediate access to the main road, urban lines, services, universities and any other necessary facility. The apartment is organized in living room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms, bathroom and balcony. The advantage of the property is the functional layout with the possibility of dividing it into 2 apartments. Orientation South-West, offering natural lighting throughout the day. The apartment is suitable both for living and for business activities, such as offices, clinics, studios, etc. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
